name: kartevoirtas-full-webpage
description: Kártevőirtó vállalkozás weboldala (MASTER sablon) — statikus HTML/CSS/JS + Cloudflare Worker ajánlatkérő backend. A src/ a build-time forrás, a public/ a generált statikus kimenet, a worker/ az űrlap-endpoint.

scripts.build: node src/build.js && node scripts/generate-icons.js && node scripts/generate-og-image.js && node scripts/generate-service-art.js
scripts.check: node scripts/check-links.js && node scripts/verify-ads.js && node scripts/test-worker.mjs
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
